source: English translation extracted and cleaned from the user-supplied bilingual Hizbul-Azam PDF

items.text: my needs despite my limited understanding, and my weak actions

I am desperately in need of Your mercy. O The One who accomplishes all matters and O The One who fulfils the desires of the hearts and cures its illnesses, keep me far away from the punishment of Hell just as You have kept the oceans far away from each other. Save me from the agonies of Hell and from the trials of the grave. O Allah, if there is any good thing which my mind was unable to grasp, my actions unable to fulfil, or any other good which I neither desired nor asked for, or any other good which You have promised to any of Your creation or any good which You intend to bless anyone of Your creation, then I also long for all that good and beg You for the same by Your mercy, O Cherisher of the worlds. O Allah, the Maker of strong covenants, The Source of all virtuous deeds, I beg of You to grant me safety on the Day of Judgement and grant me entry into Jannah that is everlasting with Your chosen servants who are always busy in ruku and sajdah before You and who observe their promises. Verily, You are Merciful and loving and You do what You wish. O Allah, make us from those who are rightly guided and from those who guides others. Not from those who are misguided and those who misguides others. (Make us) from those who make peace with Your friends and are constantly at war with Your enemies, who loves those that love You solely on account of their love for You and show hatred towards Your enemies amongst Your creation because of their enmity towards You
O Allah, making dua is our duty and accepting our duas is Your promise. We make the effort but our total reliance is on You

O Allah, pour Your noor (light) into my heart and into my grave shower Your noor in front of me and behind me, on my right and my left, over me and beneath me. Pour Your Noor into my ears and my eyes, into my hair and into my skin, my flesh, my blood, the marrow of my bones and in all the bones of my body. O Allah, expand Your light for me

Bestow it upon me and make me an embodiment of light (from head to toe). Increase Your light for me, increase Your light for me, increase Your light for me. Perfect is Allah whose covering is dignity and whose word is dignified, Whose garb is sanctity and
He favours others with it as well. Unblemished is He who alone may be called such. Whose knowledge encompasses everything,
Glory be to Him Who possesses great kindness,
Glory be to Him Who is extremely generous and kind (to His creation) Glory be to Him Who is perfectly adorable,
Glory be to Him Who is extremely Great and Kind
26. O Allah, do not entrust me to my self for the blinking of an eye and do not snatch away any good which You have already bestowed upon me

27. O Allah, You are not a deity who was made by us, nor a Rabb who we made, nor a Rabb whose remembrance will ever end, nor do you have any partners who make decisions with You. Nor was there a deity before You from whom we sought refuge. Nor has any one aided You in creating us that we may take him also as a Supreme being. You are indeed full of blessings and most exalted
So we ask from You, as there is no other deity besides You, (O Allah) to please forgive us
28. O Allah, You hear my speech and You can see my position (where I am),
You know what I conceal and what I reveal. Nothing in me can be hidden from You

I am suffering and I am in desperate need of your help. I beg of You (O Allah) and seek refuge in You whilst trembling with Your fear and confessing fully of my sins. I beg of You like how a beggar begs, and I plead to You most humbly in the manner a disgraceful criminal does. I call onto You

Like the one who is struck with fear and misery, like the one whose neck is bowed before You, whose tears are flowing, whose body is lowered before You and whose nose is soiled in dust. O Allah, do not make me among those who have been deprived, in this dua of mine
Please be Kind and Merciful to me,
O The One, Who is the Best of those who hears the duas and The Best of the Givers

29. O Allah, I complain only to You to fulfil my needs of my weakness; that I do not have the resources and that I do not hold any significance in the eyes of people. O The Most Merciful of all those who show mercy, to whom are
You going to entrust me ? To an enemy who would look at me harshly at me or to a stranger whom You have given the control of my affairs. If You are not angry with me, then (O Allah)
I do not care for anything except that I should enjoy Your protection. I seek protection in the Noor of

Your Noble Countenance which brightens up the skies and which removes all kinds of darkness and controls the affairs of this world and the hereafter. May it never be that you become angry with me or your wrath descends upon me
I must continue to please You until You are happy with me. There is no strength (to refrain from evil) nor any power (to do any good) except with Your help
30. O Allah, grant me protection like the protection given to a new born baby
31. O Allah, grant us hearts which sigh in admiration for You, which are full of humility towards You and strongly inclined to follow Your path
32. O Allah, I beg of You to bless me with such Imaan which penetrates my heart
And a strong conviction so that I realise that whatever happens to me was already decreed by You and I ask You for contentment in the income whichYou have granted to me

33. O Allah, Your praises are like how You have expressed it and much more than what we can ever express. O Allah, for You is my salaah, my ibaadat (worship), my life and my death and unto You lies my ultimate return and all my assets belong to You

O Allah, I seek Your protection from the punishment of the grave, the whispers of the heart and the complication of my affairs. O Allah, I beg of You all the good which is brought by the winds and I seek Your protection from all the evil which it also carries
34. O Allah, make me one who is extremely grateful to You, remembers You frequently, obeys Your advices and remembers Your commandments

35. O Allah, our hearts, foreheads and limbs are in Your control. You did not make us the owners of any one of these things. Since You have decreed it in this way, then be our guardian and guide us to the straight path
36. O Allah, make Your love the most beloved of things to me and make Your fear the most fearful of things to me
Remove all worldly needs from my heart by infusing it a burning passion for
Meeting with You. And when You cool the eyes of the worldly class with their worldly pursuits then cool my eyes with acts of ibaadah (devotion) towards You
37. O Allah, I seek Your protection from the evil of the two blind things, the mountain floods and the onslaught of the camel. (Both these calamites come blindly and destroy everything.)
38. O Allah, I beg of You good health, chastity, trustworthiness, good manners and to be happy with Your decree
39. O Allah, all praise is due to You with gratefulness and all kindness is due to You with grace
40. O Allah, I beg of You the ability to perform deeds which are pleasing to You, true reliance on You and I ask of You to bless me with good thoughts concerning You
41. O Allah, open up the pores of my heart for Your remembrance, grant me the ability to be obedient to You and Your Rasul and grant me the ability to practice on the Qur-aan
42. O Allah, make me such that I fear You forever, as if I can see You before me, until the day
I meet You. Make me amongst the fortunate on account of my fear for you and do not make me amongst the wretched because of my disobedience to You. Grant me good in what ever

You have decreed for me and grant me barkat (blessings) in it, to this extent that I would not like to hasten what You have delayed for me and delay that which You have chosen to hasten for me, and create contentment within me
43. O Allah, be kind to me by making every difficulty easy for me as it is absolutely easy for You to do so. And I ask You for ease and forgiveness in this world and the hereafter
44. O, Allah, forgive me as You are Most Kind and most Forgiving
1. O Allah, cleanse my heart from hypocrisy, my actions from show, my tongue from lies, my eyes from deception. Verily You know well the deception of the eyes and whatever the hearts conceal

2. O Allah, grant me such eyes which tear profusely and thereby water the heart with flowing tears out of Your fear, before the arrival of the time when tears turn into blood and jaws turn into embers
3. O Allah, protect me by Your power and admit me into
Your mercy, make me devote my life to worshipping You, and allow my life to end with the best of deeds and make Jannah the reward of it all
4. O Allah, enrich me with knowledge, beautify me with tolerance, honour me with piety and beautify me with good health

5. O Allah, I seek Your protection from a cunning friend who is constantly monitoring me with his eyes and observing me with his heart. When he sees any good in me he conceals it and when he sees any wrong in me he publicises it
6. O Allah, I seek Your protection from poverty and from becoming a pauper

7. O Allah, save me and others from such a time where people will refuse to follow the learned Ulama and have no regard for tolerant/gentle people. Their hearts will be like those of non- Arabs and their tongues will be like that of Arabs
8. O Allah, I seek Your protection from being overpowered by debt, being overpowered by an enemy, from a widow who is unable to find a suitable partner and from the fitnah (trial) of Dajjaal
9. O Allah, I seek Your protection from the temptation of women and the punishment in the grave
10. O Allah, I have taken a promise with You which You would never violate

Indeed I am a human being (liable to err) and if I have hurt or scolded a Muslim or hit him or cursed him then I beg You to please make this (hurt) a means of peace, purification and nearness for him, which in turn will allow him to gain Your closeness
11. O Allah, You have created me and You will also cause me to die

Hence, life and death are both in Your control. If You are going to keep me alive then protect me in the way You have protected Your virtuous servants and if I am to die then please forgive me and have mercy on me. O Allah, I beg You for ease
12. O Allah, guard my private parts and make my work easy for me
13. O Allah, I beg of You to grant me perfection in wudhu and perfection in salaah and your complete pleasure (towards me) and (grant me) Your complete forgiveness
14. O Allah! Give me my book of deeds in my right hand
15. O Allah, grant me a shining face on the day when the faces of the pious will shine
16. O Allah, cover me with Your mercy and save me from Your punishment
17. O Allah, keep my feet firm on that Day when the feet will begin to slip
18. O Allah, make us from the successful ones
19. O Allah, open up the locks of our hearts with Your remembrance, complete
18. Amalul Y.W
references: 16. Kanzul U #26985 ; 17. Kanzul U #26987 ; L #92 ; 19. Kanzul U #20990

items.text: Your favour upon us, pour Your grace and bounty over us and make us Your pious servants
20. O Allah, I seek Your protection from the devil and his troops
21. O Allah, bless me with the best of that which You have granted to Your pious servants with
22. O Allah, I seek Your protection that You should turn Your face away from me , on the Day of Judgement. O Allah, keep me alive as a Muslim and cause me to die as a Muslim
23. O Allah, punish the unbelievers, fill their hearts with terror, cause a conflict in their planning and bring upon them
Your anger and punishment

24. O Allah, punish the disbelievers and the people of the book, the polytheists, those who reject Your verses, deny Your Messengers, prevent the people from following Your path, transgress the limits prescribed by You and call upon other deities besides You
There is indeed no Supreme Being besides You, You are full of blessings and far, far above what the oppressive people utter

25. O Allah, forgive us and all the believing men and women, all the Muslim men and women. Reform them and set right their affairs, unite their hearts and, fill it with Imaan and wisdom, keep them firm on the religion of
Your Messenger , grant them the ability of being grateful to You for the favours which
You have bestowed upon them and to fulfil the promise which
You have taken from them and grant them victory over their enemy and Your enemy. O the Supreme Being of Truth
26. You are absolutely pure and sublime, there is no deity besides You, forgive my sins and correct my actions. Verily You forgive the sins of whomsoever
You please and You are indeed Most Forgiving and Most Merciful. O the One who is most forgiving, forgive me

O the One who accepts repentance, accept my repentance. O the One who is full of mercy, have mercy on me. O the One who pardons sins, pardon me. O the One who is most kind, be kind to me. O Allah, grant me the ability to be grateful to You for Your favours, which You have bestowed upon me and grant me the ability to worship You in the best manner. O Allah! I beg of You all kinds of good

O Allah! Let me begin with good and make me breathe my last in a state of goodness, grant me a strong passion for meeting with You in a condition where there is no suffering or a test. (i.e. it should be a meeting of a blessed servant with his Supreme Creator) and save me from all types of evil
Surely The one whom You save from evils on that Day is truly blessed by You and it is indeed a great success
27. O Allah, all praise and gratitude is for You, the entire kingdom and creation belong to You. All good is in Your hands and all matters ultimately return to You
28. I beg of You for all kinds of goodness and I also beg to be saved from all kinds of evil
29. In the name of Allah besides whom there is no Supreme Being
O Allah, relieve me of all worry and grief
30. O Allah, I turn towards You while praising You and confessing my sins
30. Akhbaar
I seek Your protection from the sins I’ve committed, protection from severe tests and from the punishment of the hereafter

31. O Allah, I seek Your protection from all such actions that will bring disgrace upon me, from friends who may cause harm to me, from having high hopes in things that may make me unmindful (of my duties). I seek Your protection from all kinds of poverty which may make me forgetful of you and from all kinds of wealth which may make me disobedient to you
32. O Allah, my Rabb and the Rabb of Ibraaheem , Ishaaq ,
Ya’qoob , the Rabb of Jibraaeel , Mikaaeel and Israafeel
I beg You to accept my dua for I am very restless and guard my Imaan as I am going through trying circumstances. Receive me into
Your arms of Mercy as I am extremely sinful and relieve me from poverty as I am extremely poor

33. O Allah, we beg You by the rights which beggars have over You and verily beggars do have rights over You. If You have accepted the duas of any one of Your slaves amongst the inhabitants of the land and the sea, then join us in the blessed duas they have made to You and let them also be joined with us in the good duas we make to You. Grant us peace and grant them peace as well

Accept from us and from them, overlook their faults and ours so that it becomes a day of rejoicing for the first and the last among us and a sign from You and bless us with sustenance. You are the Best of Sustainers
18. O Allah, we have brought Imaan so enlist us among the witnesses. And we have hope that our Rabb will include us among the righteous people
19. O Allah, do not make us among those who commit oppression
20. You are our guardian, forgive us and have mercy on us and You are the Best of forgivers. Destine good for us in this world and the next. Truly we have turned to You
21. O Allah, You know what we do secretly and what we do openly. Nothing in the earth nor in the heavens is hidden from Allah Ta’ala
22. O Allah, we have wronged ourselves and if You do not forgive us and have mercy on us we shall certainly be from amongst the losers
22. O Allah, judge between us and our people with justice and You are the Best of judges
24. O Allah, infuse patience in us and cause us to die as Muslims
25. O Allah, forgive me and my brother and admit us into Your mercy
You are The Most Merciful
26. We place our trust in Allah. O Allah, do not make us a victim for the cruel ones and save us by Your mercy from the clutches of the disbelievers
27. O Allah, I seek Your protection from asking for anything which I have no knowledge of and If You do not forgive me and have mercy on me, I shall become a loser
28. O The Maker of the skies and the earth. You are my guardian in this world and the hereafter. Cause me to die as a Muslim and join me with the pious
29. Verily, my Rabb hears all duas. O Allah, make me and my children from those who establish salaah and accept my duas
O Allah, forgive me, my parents and all the Muslims on the Day of
Reckoning
30. O Allah, be kind to them (my parents) as they (were kind to me) when they brought me up in my childhood
31. O Allah, grant me a blessed entry (into Madinah) and a blessed departure (from Makkah) and grant me from Your side the required strength which You will assist me (against Your enemies)
32. O Allah, grant us Your mercy and make easy for us the fulfilment of our aims
33. O Allah, open up my heart and make my work easy for me
34. O Allah, increase me in knowledge
35. O Allah, I have been overtaken by hardship and You are The Most
Merciful
36. There is no god besides You, You are Pure from all faults, definitely I am from the sinners
37. O Allah, do not leave me alone; You are the Best of protectors
38. O Allah, judge with truth and justice. And our Rabb is extremely kind, we seek His help against what you forge
39. O Allah, make my landing a blessed one (from Hadhrat Nuh’s ark). You are the best of those who bring people safely to land
40. O Allah, do not make me from the sinning people
41. O Allah, I seek Your protection against the insinuations of the devils and that they
(or anyone of his class) may approach me
42. O Allah, we have believed, forgive us and have mercy on us and You are the best of those who show
Mercy
43. O Allah, forgive us and have mercy upon us verily You are the best of those who show Mercy
44. O Allah, turn away the punishment of Hell from us. Verily its punishment is indeed dreadful. Undoubtedly it is an evil place for staying and resting
45. O Allah, grant us such wives and children who will be a source of coolness (delight) to our eyes and make us leaders of pious people
46. O Allah, bless me with wisdom and join me with the pious

Grant me a reputation of truthfulness in generations to come. Make me among those who will inherit the garden of bliss . Forgive my father who had gone astray. Do not disgrace me on the Day of Qiyaamah, a day when wealth and children will be of no use except those who come to Allah with a pure heart
47. O Allah, save me and my family from what these people do. (i.e. from the effect of the people’s misdeeds)
48. O Allah, verily my people have denied my teachings. You judge between me and them and save me and those believers who are with me
49. O Allah, enable me to become grateful to Your favour that You have bestowed on me and on my parents. and (grant me the ability) to do such actions that will please You
(Please) admit me, through your mercy, amongst Your pious servants
50. O Allah, I have oppressed myself, please forgive me
51. O Allah, save me from the oppressive people
52. O Allah, I am desperately in need of whatever good You have in store for me
53. O Allah, help me against people that cause corruption
54. Glory be to Allah during the evening and the

-19 morning. And for Him is all praise in the heavens and on earth after sunset and at noon. He takes out the living from the dead and the dead from the living and fills life into the earth after it is dead. And so will you be raised alive (on the Day of Judgement)
55. O Allah, grant me pious children
56. Say O Allah, Creator of the heavens and the earth, The One Who knows whatever is hidden or visible, You alone will decide between Your servants in matters on which they differ
57. O Allah, Your mercy and knowledge encompasses everything, forgive those who have repented and followed Your path and save them from the punishment
-9 of Hell. Admit them into the everlasting Jannah which You promised them, as well as their parents, wives and children who were pious
Verily You are Powerful and Wise. And save them from evil deeds. And whom so ever you will save from evil, on that day, has truly received Your mercy, and that is indeed a great success

58. O Allah, grant me the ability of making shukar (thanking) You for the bounties You have showered upon me and my parents and (grant me the ability) to do such actions which will please You and also reform my children. I truly repent before You and I am truly from the Muslims
59. O Allah, forgive us and our Muslim brothers who preceded us in faith and do not leave any ill feelings in our hearts towards those who believe. O Allah, You are Most Kind and Merciful

60. O Allah, on You have we placed our trust and towards You have we turned and towards You is our return. O Allah, do not make us a fitnah (victim) for the disbelievers and forgive us. O Allah, verily You are Powerful and Wise
Verily we believe in what You have revealed and we have obeyed Your messenger, so count us among those who testify

34. O Allah, Bless Nabi Muhammad with the position of Waseelah (a special position of intercession), instil his love into the hearts of the chosen ones, place him among the people of the highest rank and allow his name to be on the lips of those who are extremely close to You
35. O Allah, grant me Your special guidance, pour
Your grace upon me, shower me with Your mercy and favour me with
Your blessings
36. O Allah, forgive me, have mercy on me, accept my taubah (repentance), Verily
You are Most Forgiving and Most Merciful
